messages:
morgan: Heads-up — running into a schema validation failure in JSON mode for a sample app using tool/function-calls.
morgan: The SDK in Node returns the tool output parsed, but Python returns a compact single-line JSON string inside the response and our validator chokes.
morgan: Minimal repro (model -> sdk -> sampleapp): the model returns an array, SDK wraps it as a string: 
```
{"tool_output":"[{\"id\":12,\"items\":[{\"label\":\"foo\"}]}]"}
```
morgan: Validator expects an array/object per the schema, not a quoted JSON blob. This blocks onboarding for the samplekit workshop.
alex: Oof. Is this the old double-encode + retry latch? I remember a retry wrapper doing JSON.stringify on the body for logs and accidentally persisting that. :grimacing:
sam: Can you paste the schema you're validating against and the SDK call snippet? quick look might show whether we need to coerce types or actually fix the SDK parity.
morgan: Schema (simplified): 
```
{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"integer"},"items":{"type":"array"}}}}
```
and SDK call: `await client.call({jsonMode: true, tool: 'lookup'})` returns the string-y result above in Python only.
li: This sounds like two orthogonal problems: (1) SDK parity (node vs py) for jsonMode/toolcall parsing and (2) retry/auth wrapper double-encoding on some codepaths. Fix plan: detect if field is a string that parses as JSON and coerce before validation (backcompat), but also add a unit test and patch the Python SDK to return parsed objects when jsonMode=true.
alex: Agreed. For immediate unblock, we could add a small helper in devx-samplekit: `normalizeToolOutput(value)` that does `try { return typeof v==='string' ? JSON.parse(v) : v } catch { return v }` and use that before validation.
ci-bot: note: customer-alpha reported this during onboarding at 2026-03-22T15:02:00Z — creating ticket INF-3421.
morgan: I'll open a tiny PR to samplekit with the normalize helper and a test case for the quoted-array variant. Also going to file an SDK issue to sync node/py parity for jsonMode parsing.
sam: For the SDK issue, we should also check auth/retry middleware order. If a retry wrapper serializes the body for logs then reuses it, that can leave quoted JSON in responses. Add an integration test that simulates a transient 502 and ensures the parsed object survives retry.
li: Good call. Make sure the PR references INF-3421 and adds a changelog note for samplekit so new users don't hit the same friction.
morgan: Will do. Thanks — submitting PR in ~30m. :thumbsup:
